name: cdc_leash
title: Issue #2155 (2026-11-11): how far actors on Continue During Combat packages move in combat. On the Searchlight Airport runway (save nvfairport), one actor at a time is spawned 500, 1,000 or 2,000 units up the runway from the standing player (god mode), given its package there by AddScriptPackage at sample 60 (so 'near current location' is that spot), set on the player with StartCombat at sample 300 and stopped with StopCombat at sample 1400 (about 15 samples a second). The leash is the actor's greatest distance from the spot where it got the package. Melee troopers (a knife), rifle troopers (control), a coyote, and V22FemaleMantis on its own flagged package; '_none' sessions are the baseline with no package given; Every session raises the player's Health and restores it twice a second, so a restart without god mode cannot kill the player. '_away' sessions teleport the player 1,500 units down the runway at sample 900. Sessions added after the first results (a Guard of radius 512 stood, a Guard of radius 0 chased): the player nearer the post; Guard packages near the editor location, which for a spawned actor is where PlaceAtMe put it ('_walk' sessions: the player walks away from that fixed post); creatures with the player moved off mid-fight ('_then_1000'). A scan of depth 1 reaches the player's own cell only, so sessions in which the player leaves the cell scan at depth 2.
